rules.name: xoga713-var-mult-legacy-selfcheck
rules.sql: SELECT c.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_type, p.constant_curr_mult, p.curr_mult_factor, s.settle_value AS fx, c.curr_mult AS stored_curr_mult, CASE WHEN p.curr_mult_type = 'multiplication' THEN p.constant_curr_mult * s.settle_value WHEN p.curr_mult_type = 'division' THEN p.constant_curr_mult / s.settle_value END AS formula_curr_mult FROM dbsystemuat.curr_mult_table c JOIN dbsystemuat.var_product_code_mapping_table v ON v.invenio_product_code = c.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.product_master_table p ON p.invenio_product_code = c.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table s ON s.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor AND s.value_date = c.value_date WHERE c.value_date = :cob AND (c.curr_mult IS NULL OR s.settle_value IS NULL OR abs(c.curr_mult - CASE WHEN p.curr_mult_type = 'multiplication' THEN p.constant_curr_mult * s.settle_value WHEN p.curr_mult_type = 'division' THEN p.constant_curr_mult / s.settle_value END) > 0.000000001 * abs(c.curr_mult)) ORDER BY c.invenio_product_code
SELECT count(*) AS stored_rows FROM dbsystemuat.curr_mult_table WHERE value_date = :cob

expect.reason: legacy holds about 124 stored rows per date
the stored curr_mult_table value must equal the sp_curr_mult_extract formula; rows listed here are products where legacy MATLAB stored something else (CM JN, CM CRD)
